assumptions.prior: Research-only Beta(1,1) per item and production mode; no passive updates.
assumptions.graph: Separate mixture with at most one assessed outcome per other independently declared family; weight min(.85,4/(4+target direct count)). Requires at least three families and stipulated-supported same operation/reading.
assumptions.truth: Prediction worlds explicitly assume shared operation, independent memorization, separate readings, conflict, or reversed transfer domain. These are generated conditions, not linguistic findings.
assumptions.help: Help changes latent response probability by gain*(1-p), with deterministic keyed learner variation in [0.8,1.2]. It adds no assessed evidence.
assumptions.retention: At the common delayed test, only retention times the simulated gain remains; baseline probability stays constant except in the explicitly stale-history world.
assumptions.time: Both policies have identical content, estimator, 20-second probes, 40-second help and wall-clock budget; unspent time remains ordinary task time with no invented extra learning. Final test occurs seven days after the same budget deadline.
assumptions.policy: Fixed practice visits the same criticality-ordered pool and always probes then helps. Diagnostic decisions require different outcome-dependent help/continue actions; known low-uncertainty gaps may receive help directly. No bandit or learned policy.
assumptions.randomness: Keyed common random numbers for learner/item probe outcome, learning response, and delayed outcome, shared by policies. Prediction models see identical observations and held-out outcomes.
assumptions.selection: No parameters are fitted or selected on these results; worlds include explicit failure cases. Twelve fixed-seed replicate means and sample SD describe only these simulations.

reproducibility.timestampPolicy: No wall-clock timestamp is embedded; equal inputs and source produce equal output bytes.
